title: AlgoLounge Foundations
description: Master essential algorithms and data structures through curated problems. Progress from fundamentals to advanced topics with a proven learning path covering 17 key categories.

units.title: Arrays & Hashing
units.description: Master array manipulation and hash table techniques. Foundation patterns for solving complex algorithmic problems efficiently.

units.title: Two Pointers
units.description: Learn efficient array and string manipulation using the two-pointer technique. Essential for optimizing solutions from O(n²) to O(n).

units.title: Stack
units.description: Master stack-based problem solving including monotonic stacks, expression evaluation, and parenthesis matching.

units.title: Binary Search
units.description: Master the binary search algorithm and its variations. Learn to solve problems in O(log n) time complexity.

units.title: Sliding Window
units.description: Learn to optimize subarray and substring problems using the sliding window technique for linear time solutions.

units.title: Linked List
units.description: Master linked list manipulation including reversal, cycle detection, merging, and pointer techniques.

units.title: Trees
units.description: Build expertise in tree traversals, binary search trees, and tree manipulation. Foundation for advanced graph algorithms.

units.title: Tries
units.description: Learn trie (prefix tree) data structures for efficient string operations and word search problems.

units.title: Backtracking
units.description: Learn recursive backtracking for solving constraint satisfaction and combinatorial problems.

units.title: Heap / Priority Queue
units.description: Master heap data structures and priority queues for efficient top-K problems and scheduling algorithms.

units.title: Graphs
units.description: Master graph traversal algorithms (DFS, BFS), cycle detection, and connected component problems.

units.title: 1D Dynamic Programming
units.description: Build dynamic programming foundations with 1D array problems. Essential preparation for complex DP patterns.

units.title: Intervals
units.description: Master interval problems including merging, scheduling, and overlap detection. Common in meeting room scenarios.

units.title: Greedy
units.description: Learn greedy algorithms for optimization problems. Make locally optimal choices to find global solutions.

units.title: Advanced Graphs
units.description: Advanced graph algorithms including topological sort, union find, and Eulerian paths.

units.title: 2D Dynamic Programming
units.description: Advanced dynamic programming with 2D arrays and matrices. Master complex state transitions and optimizations.

units.title: Bit Manipulation
units.description: Master bitwise operations and bit manipulation tricks. Essential for low-level optimization and clever solutions.
